candidates.reason: Direct unit test for scrapy.utils.misc.walk_modules_iter, the symbol named in the PR checklist: it imports walk_modules_iter and walk_modules from scrapy.utils.misc and asserts the exact set of modules returned when walking a package (tests.test_utils_misc.test_walk_modules) and an egg (test.egg), plus the import-error path and the walk_modules deprecation warning. Any change to module-walking/import semantics under Python 3.15 surfaces here first.

Closest indirect consumer: scrapy.spiderloader.SpiderLoader._load_all_spiders walks configured spider modules with scrapy.utils.misc.walk_modules_iter and relies on its error semantics (ImportError/SyntaxError, lazily raised while iterating). These tests exercise that walk for single, multiple and addon spider modules and for broken modules.

Command discovery goes through scrapy.cmdline._iter_command_classes, which yields commands by calling walk_modules_iter over scrapy.commands and COMMANDS_MODULE. This file imports scrapy.cmdline.execute and runs the CLI in-process, so it traverses walk_modules_iter for both the built-in and project command modules.

Co-located tests for the other version-sensitive behavior in scrapy/utils/misc.py: is_generator_with_return_value parses dedented source with ast, so interpreter-version changes to parsing/expectations are pinned here. It is the complementary scrapy.utils.misc test module for the same file touched by the PR.
